=== 8. external: Mula AVX2 Harley-Seal, and its observed CSA threshold ===
# AVX2_harley_seal::popcnt runs its 16-way carry-save network over
# 'limit = size - size % 16' 256-bit words, so the network engages only at
# 16 vectors = 512 bytes = 64 u64 words. Below that the loop body never
# runs and only the per-vector tail reduction executes. The stride is
# visible as the loop's pointer advance and its trip-count masking.
    35da:	and    $0xffffffffffffffe0,%rsp
    35fa:	and    $0xfffffffffffffff0,%rdx
    3664:	add    $0x200,%rax
    368b:	vpand  %ymm5,%ymm1,%ymm1
    368f:	vpand  %ymm2,%ymm3,%ymm5
    36a7:	vpand  %ymm3,%ymm6,%ymm3
    36ab:	vpand  %ymm2,%ymm5,%ymm6
    36b7:	vpand  %ymm4,%ymm1,%ymm1
    36bf:	vpand  %ymm3,%ymm2,%ymm4
    36df:	vpand  %ymm5,%ymm4,%ymm4
    36e3:	vpand  %ymm6,%ymm3,%ymm5
    36fb:	vpand  %ymm3,%ymm6,%ymm3
# Vendored source line fixing the same stride:
33:  const uint64_t limit = size - size % 16;
# And its 32-byte byte-tail boundary:
79:  for (size_t i = size - size % 32; i < size; i++)

# compiler lowers to vmovdqa. This is why the arm refuses word_offset != 0.
